# calculating the interaction rates in both directions

```{julia}
cfg = load_config(joinpath(run_path, "config.json"))
a1 = filter(row -> row.time > 10 && row.bee1_id == 1, elog)
a2 = filter(row -> row.time > 10 && row.bee1_id == 2, elog)
acc_a1t1 = unique(a1.task_1)
acc_a1t2 = unique(a1.task_2)
acc_a2t1 = unique(a2.task_1)
acc_a2t2 = unique(a2.task_2)
println("unique accuracies for agent 1: acc_task1 = ", unique(a1.task_1))
println("unique accuracies for agent 1: acc_task2 = ", unique(a1.task_2))
println("unique accuracies for agent 2: acc_task1 = ", unique(a2.task_1))
println("unique accuracies for agent 2: acc_task2 = ", unique(a2.task_2))
```

```{julia}
int_pref = cfg.interaction_rate[1]
sig_sens = cfg.lambda_sensitivity[1]
#sig_sens = 10000
sigmoid_a1 = 1/(1 + exp(-sig_sens*(acc_a2t1[1] - acc_a1t1[1])))
sigmoid_a2 = 1/(1 + exp(-sig_sens*(acc_a1t1[1] - acc_a2t1[1])))
int_rate_task1_a1 = int_pref * acc_a1t1[1] * acc_a2t1[1] * sigmoid_a1
int_rate_task1_a2 = int_pref * acc_a1t1[1] * acc_a2t1[1] * sigmoid_a2
println("interaction rates, agent 1 getting suppressed by agent 2 in task 1: ", int_rate_task1_a1)
println("interaction rates, agent 2 getting suppressed by agent 1 in task 1: ", int_rate_task1_a2)
```
